Workflows.title: Internal Fund Transfer
Workflows.goal: Initiate a transfer between accounts and verify it in history.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://www.ngpf.org/bank-sim/transfer
2. Click 'GET STARTED NOW'
3. Click 'TRANSFERS' menu
4. Click 'MAKE A TRANSFER'
5. Select 'SINGLE' frequency
6. Select 'CHECKING' from 'Transfer From'
7. Select 'SAVING' from 'Transfer To'
8. Enter '50' in 'Amount'
9. Enter '04/10/2026' in 'Payment Date'
10. Click 'Save'
11. Navigate to 'DISPLAY ALL TRANSFERS' to verify.

Workflows.title: Bill Payment and Recipient Management
Workflows.goal: Add a recipient and attempt to pay a bill.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://www.ngpf.org/bank-sim/pay-bill
2. Click 'GET STARTED NOW'
3. Click 'BILLS' menu
4. Click 'MANAGE RECIPIENT'
5. Click 'ADD RECIPIENT', fill details, and submit
6. Click 'PAY BILL'
7. Select recipient, enter amount, and submit
8. Navigate to 'DISPLAY ALL BILLS' to verify.

Workflows.title: Check Deposit Simulation
Workflows.goal: Submit a check deposit with account selection and amount.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://www.ngpf.org/bank-sim/deposit-checks
2. Click 'GET STARTED NOW'
3. Select 'CHECKING' account
4. Enter '50.00' in 'Amount'
5. Note: File upload for check images is required to enable 'Submit'.

Workflows.title: Online Shopping Simulation
Workflows.goal: Select items and complete a purchase transaction.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://www.ngpf.org/bank-sim/online-shop
2. Click 'GET STARTED NOW'
3. Select items via checkboxes
4. Click 'Save'
5. Verify 'Transactions added successfully' message.

Workflows.title: Profile Update
Workflows.goal: Attempt to update user profile information.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://www.ngpf.org/bank-sim/manage-profile
2. Click 'GET STARTED NOW'
3. Click 'MANAGE PROFILE'
4. Attempt to enter address details and click 'Save'.
